title_zh: 调换预约并解决共用录音室冲突

scenario.label_zh: 共用录音室重复预约处理
scenario.goal_zh: 查明两份日历造成的冲突，调换预约时段并在共用日历中确认更新

context_zh: 两位同事发现录音室被同时安排了两项工作。
author: author-phase09-a

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: We both have the studio at two. How can we resolve this without cancelling either recording?

sentences.speaker: Ian
sentences.text: I booked on the wall calendar. You used the online one, so we never saw each other.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: My guest can come at four instead. Would you be able to finish by then?

sentences.speaker: Ian
sentences.text: Yes. If you take four to five and I keep two to three, that would settle it.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: That works for my guest; she has already offered four as an alternative. I'll change my booking now.

sentences.speaker: Ian
sentences.text: I am looking at the online calendar. Yes, yours is now at four, and mine is at two.

sentences.speaker: Zoe
sentences.text: Great. I will mark the wall calendar as out of use so that we both use the online one from now on.

targets.sense_zh: 解决争议；使问题得到处理
